unmeasured.label: Strategy result vs closing-line value
unmeasured.note: Requires a licensed, timestamped opening-to-closing price history. The league publishes no such series, so no value is asserted and gate G5 cannot be evaluated.

unmeasured.label: Strategy edge vs market-implied probability
unmeasured.note: Requires a timestamped market-implied probability series matched to each decision. Not available from an official source, so no correlation is claimed.

unmeasured.label: Player prop outcome vs team total
unmeasured.note: The pairing is well defined, but a per-decision price is needed to turn the historical relationship into an edge. The historical relationship itself is measurable once the full game-book set is collected.

unmeasured.label: Practice participation vs game designation
unmeasured.note: The official report publishes both designations but no conversion table, and the league's historical archive is not machine-readable in a citable form. No percentage conversion is asserted.
